# Relay Automation and Relay

> Relay Automation is the SaaS company behind Relay, a B2B SaaS customer onboarding workspace founded by Mohamed Shajith.

## Product and audience

Relay is the product name. Relay Automation is the distinct SaaS company and official website at relayautomation.tech. Its founder is Mohamed Shajith.

Relay is for implementation, onboarding, and professional-services teams at B2B SaaS companies. Teams can map onboarding processes, reuse templates, coordinate customer information and tasks through a customer portal, track readiness and delivery operations, configure email reminders, and review portfolio status.

Relay organizes onboarding work; it does not automatically configure a customer's software.

## Verified product boundaries

- HubSpot handoff is optional and requires provider setup and workspace-owner configuration for a pipeline, Closed Won stage, and Relay template.
- Email reminders depend on email delivery and scheduled processing being configured.
- Relay tracks budget, forecast, actual cost, margin notes, invoice status, and invoice reference. It does not generate invoices, accept payments, or connect to accounting systems.
- The public sample workspace uses fictional data.
- Relay does not claim customer outcomes, certifications, or unsupported integrations.
